name: multi-view-core
title: Multi-view core
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Field schema and pure helpers for one collection shown in many views: search, filter, sort, group, month grid, timeline scale, Intl formatting, and CSV.

meta.descriptionEs: Esquema de campos y funciones puras para buscar, filtrar, ordenar, agrupar, armar el mes y el cronograma, y exportar CSV.

examples.title: Formato y búsqueda
examples.description: Moneda compacta en es-MX y en-US, y una fecha que no cambia de día.

meta.usage:
formatCurrency(42000, "en-US")
searchRecords(records, fields, query, locale)
monthGrid(2026, 3, 1)

api.name: FieldDef
api.description: id, label, type, icon, options, currency, format, section, readOnly.

api.name: ViewConfig
api.description: kind plus the fields that title, group, date, or cover a view.

api.name: searchRecords / filterRecords / sortRecords
api.description: Pure list transforms. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and never shift with the timezone.

api.name: monthGrid / moveRange / resizeRange
api.description: Monday-first month grid and timeline move or resize by one zoom unit.

api.name: recordsToCsv
api.description: Uses the shared CSV helper, including spreadsheet-formula escaping.

docs: Pure field schema and helpers for the view-* items. No React and no data fetching. Pass a locale from the host. This is not a table component: keep data-table, crm-table, and adaptive-table for those jobs.
